# API — TeamSync

The machine interfaces of TeamSync. There is **no HTTP API**: TeamSync runs entirely in the browser,
and agents use the local MCP server. The block between the `forge:api` markers is generated by
`pnpm generate` from `app.config.ts` (`modes.urlParams`, `modes.postMessage`, `modes.mcp.tools`) —
edit the config, never the block.

<!-- forge:api:start — generated from app.config.ts by scripts/generate.ts; do not edit -->
## URL parameters
- `teams` = 2–10 (default 2): Number of teams to make (names are never put in the link)
- `lang` = en | bg (default en): Interface language for this visit (without it: your saved choice, else English); it is not saved
- `embed` = 1: compact embed mode (also automatic inside an iframe); see Embed below
- Example: https://simeontsvetanov.github.io/teamsync-random-team-generator/?teams=2&lang=en

Internal (set by the app or the operating system; not for links you write):
- `share-target` = 1 (+ title, text, url): Android “Share → TeamSync”: the shared text becomes the names list; the parameters are removed from the address bar right away

App shortcuts (long-press the installed app icon):
- Make 2 teams: https://simeontsvetanov.github.io/teamsync-random-team-generator/?teams=2
- Make 3 teams: https://simeontsvetanov.github.io/teamsync-random-team-generator/?teams=3

## Embed (iframe + postMessage)
- Markup: <iframe src="https://simeontsvetanov.github.io/teamsync-random-team-generator/?embed=1" title="TeamSync"></iframe>
- Origin rules: the app only works with the page that embeds it — its origin is taken from document.referrer.
  Requests are accepted only when event.origin equals that origin and event.source is window.parent; anything else
  (including messages that fail validation or are too large) is ignored without a reply. The app posts events only
  to that exact origin, never "*". With no referrer (e.g. referrerpolicy="no-referrer") the embed stays silent.
- Every message is an object `{ type: "teamsync:<name>", ...payload }`.

Requests (host page → app):
- `teamsync:make`: Make teams from these names (the names box shows them, then the result is posted back).
  - `names` (string[], required, ≤ 1,000 names, each ≤ 100 characters; blank entries are ignored; whole message ≤ 120,000 characters): The people to split.
  - `teams` (number (integer), required, 2–10): How many teams to make.

Events (app → host page):
- `teamsync:ready`: TeamSync is loaded and listening for teamsync:make.
  - (no fields)
- `teamsync:result`: The teams were made (after teamsync:make or a tap on Generate teams / Shuffle again).
  - `teams` (string[][], required): One array of names per team; sizes differ by at most one, bigger teams first.
- `teamsync:error`: The teams could not be made.
  - `code` (string, required): NAMES_EMPTY | NAMES_TOO_MANY | NAME_TOO_LONG | NAMES_INVALID | TEAMS_OUT_OF_RANGE | TEAMS_MORE_THAN_NAMES

## HTTP API
- none: there is no HTTP API (the app runs in the browser; agents use the MCP server)

## MCP
- Local (stdio): npx -y @simeonts/teamsync-random-team-generator-mcp
- Client config: {"mcpServers":{"teamsync-random-team-generator":{"command":"npx","args":["-y","@simeonts/teamsync-random-team-generator-mcp"]}}}

### Tool `make_teams`
Split a list of people into 2–10 fair, random teams (sizes differ by at most 1; unbiased crypto shuffle). Read-only, no network.

Input (arguments):
- `names` (string[] | string, required, array: ≤ 1,000 names, each ≤ 100 characters · text: ≤ 110,000 characters, one name per line; numbers, bullets and chat prefixes are removed): People to split: an array of names, or text with one name per line.
- `teams` (number (integer), required, 2–10, not more than the number of names): Number of teams.

Output (structuredContent; the text content holds the same result for people):
- `teams` (string[][], required): One array of names per team (the text content has the same teams ready to paste into a chat).

Errors: isError: true with text content {"code","message"}; codes INPUT_INVALID, NAMES_EMPTY, NAMES_TOO_MANY, NAME_TOO_LONG, NAMES_INVALID, TEAMS_OUT_OF_RANGE, TEAMS_MORE_THAN_NAMES.

Example call:
- arguments: {"names":["Maria","Liam","Aisha","Kenji","Elena"],"teams":2}
- structuredContent: {"teams":[["Kenji","Maria","Elena"],["Aisha","Liam"]]}
<!-- forge:api:end -->

## Notes for developers

- **Same core everywhere.** The app, the embed and `make_teams` all call
  `@simeonts/teamsync-random-team-generator-core` (`parseNames` → `makeTeams`), so limits and error
  codes are identical. Validation: Zod schemas in `app/src/teams/embed.ts` and `packages/mcp/src/tool.ts`.
- **Names never go into a URL.** Only `?teams=` is written to the address bar (`replaceState`).
- **Embed security.** No message listener outside an iframe; origin from `document.referrer`, checked
  with `===` together with `event.source === window.parent`; payload capped at 120,000 characters;
  replies only to that origin (forge-engineering → security §postMessage).
- **Versioning.** The MCP package follows the app's SemVer; a changed tool schema is a major version.
